title: Dacor — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Dacor.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Discover True Innovation." Luxury tier. Dacor was acquired by Samsung in 2016, bringing Korean tech investment to an established American luxury brand. The Modernist collection features steam-assisted cooking, a stunning LCD display, and Samsung smart home integration. The Heritage line offers traditional pro styling. Dacor competes with Thermador and Monogram, offering unique steam cooking technology.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Luxury buyers who want steam cooking built-in. Samsung ecosystem customers going luxury. Kitchen designers wanting something different from Sub-Zero/Wolf.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Dacor:

• Steam-assisted cooking built into wall ovens — unique in the luxury segment

• Samsung technology and smart home integration behind a luxury brand

• Modernist design with LCD touchscreen rivals anything in the market

• Heritage line for customers who want traditional pro styling

• Samsung financial backing means strong investment in R&D and quality
